name: Webcasata FilterX
author: webcasata

sections.description:
Webcasata FilterX lets you build powerful, Ajax-driven search widgets for your WordPress site in minutes. Filter posts by any taxonomy — including custom taxonomies created with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) — with live results, keyword highlighting, and clean pagination.

Key Features

  • Ajax search — results load without page refresh
  • Taxonomy filters — dropdown filters for any registered taxonomy (including ACF taxonomies)
  • Keyword search — searches post titles and content, constrained within selected taxonomies
  • Keyword highlighting — matched keywords are highlighted in results
  • Unlimited search items — create as many search configurations as you need
  • Shortcode — each search item generates a ready-to-use shortcode
  • Gutenberg block — insert search widgets directly in the block editor
  • Numbered pagination — clean, accessible page navigation
  • Flexible display — configure columns (1–6), posts per page, grid/list/masonry layout
  • URL sync — filter state is reflected in the URL for bookmarkable, shareable searches
  • Card customization — show title only, title + thumbnail, or title + excerpt + thumbnail
  • Custom “no results” message — set a custom message and image for empty result states
  • WordPress.org compliant — follows all WordPress coding standards

Requirements

  • Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) — free version is sufficient

Pro Version

Webcasata FilterX Pro unlocks:

  • Load More pagination
  • Infinite Scroll pagination
  • Hybrid Scroll (Infinite + Load More)
  • Search Analytics — top queries, zero-result reports
  • Custom card templates
sections.installation:
1. Ensure Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) is installed and active.
  2. Upload the webcasata-filterx folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate Webcasata FilterX from the Plugins screen.
  4. Go to Webcasata FilterX → New Search to create your first search widget.
  5. Copy the generated shortcode and paste it into any page or post.
sections.faq:
Does this work without ACF?

No — Webcasata FilterX requires ACF to be installed and active. ACF is used to define and manage custom taxonomies that power the filter dropdowns.

Can I use it with the free version of ACF?

Yes, the free version of ACF (available on WordPress.org) is all you need.

How many search widgets can I create?

Unlimited, on the free plan.

Can I search across multiple post types?

Each search widget targets one post type. You can create multiple widgets (one per post type) and place them anywhere on your site.

Will it slow down my site?

Webcasata FilterX uses WordPress’s native WP_Query with standard nonce verification. All queries run only on user interaction (not on page load). No external API calls are made.

Is the shortcode output cached?

The initial results load is triggered by JavaScript after the page loads. You can add server-side caching (e.g. via Transients or object caching) using the filterx_query_args filter hook.

How do I style the search widget?

By default, Webcasata FilterX includes a clean, lightweight stylesheet. You can disable it in Webcasata FilterX → Settings and write your own CSS. All elements have descriptive class names (.filterx-widget, .filterx-post-card, etc.).
sections.changelog:
1.0.7

  • Display Options: replaced single “Card shows” dropdown with individual Show/Hide toggles for Title, Image, Excerpt, Meta, Terms, and Button.
  • Added “Card Button Label” text field — customize the Read More button text per search form.
  • Settings: added “Hide Sort Order dropdown” toggle to remove sort control from the frontend widget.
  • Settings: added “Hide Filter tabs / dropdowns” toggle to remove taxonomy filter controls from the frontend widget.
  • Frontend: added .filterx-card-btn Read More button style.

1.0.6

  • Fixed taxonomy not loading on post type selection: moved all filterxAdmin JS data (nonce, ajaxUrl, isEdit, savedTaxonomies) into wp_localize_script() in class-filterx-assets.php.

1.0.5

  • Three-strategy ACF taxonomy detection (native WP, $wp_taxonomies global walk, ACF CPT meta).

1.0.4

  • Modern stepped admin UI with locked/unlocked steps.

1.0.3

  • Added Load More pagination to free version.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
